description: This source file defines the class 'ColumnLeft' which extends a system engine controller for the OpenCart admin panel. It constructs the left column menu in the admin interface, dynamically generating menu items based on permissions and organizing them into a hierarchical array structure.

classes.name: ColumnLeft
classes.description: Represents the admin panel's left sidebar menu, creating a hierarchical menu structure based on user permissions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Builds and returns the HTML for the admin panel's left menu, including various sections like Dashboard, Catalog, CMS, Extensions, Design, and more, conditioned on user permissions.
